0022600153.text: The Rockets (5-0, first in the Southwest and the West, 2-0 at home) take a five-game winning streak into their seventh game of the season, but Alperen Sengun, Reed Sheppard and Steven Adams are all out, while the Thunder (4-1, first in the Northwest, 4th in the West, 3-0 at home) are missing Alex Caruso, Cason Wallace, Chet Holmgren, Jalen Williams, Nikola Topic and Thomas Sorber. The teams have not played each other yet in 2026-27, and the Rockets lost their 2025-26 season series 1-2. Houston won the most recent meeting 112-106 in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026, in a regular season game.
